title: Header & navigation shell
scope: desktop and mobile Search entry points
visualChanges: Raw cream/border shell colors are replaced by the W7 semantic surface/line vocabulary.
The sticky header gains restrained depth and translucency rather than a heavy card treatment.
Desktop dropdowns use a paper surface with a gold top rule to reinforce hierarchy and Makati identity.
Search is the shell's clearest gold-accent action on both desktop and mobile.
Mobile utility controls gain explicit bordered surfaces so Search, barangay and Menu read as a coherent control cluster.
The BetterBarangay bar uses a restrained green gradient and a lightly surfaced homepage action while retaining the gold Better wordmark treatment.
preserved: Existing navigation information architecture and labels
transparent native barangay selectors with visible focus proxies
